current_sampler.parent_parameters: Saved old-formula epsilon_mean and epsilon_std_population, not new absolute distance/price moments.
current_sampler.method: scipy.stats.truncnorm Normal(mu,sigma) conditioned on E>0; zero-sigma returns positive mu; numerical <=0 draw replaced by nextafter(0,1)
current_sampler.support: Arbitrarily small positive values possible mathematically; no empirical lower floor or finite upper cap.
current_sampler.fallback: Exact WeatherCode×Period → Period → WeatherCode → global; default generic error mode overridden by final runtime hierarchical mode.
current_sampler.rng: Explicit persistent numpy Generator; final runtime default_rng(seed), seed42 baseline; passed to SciPy random_state. No RNG draws in this analysis.

zero_semantics.old: Delta_P zero not excluded: gives old epsilon0 if retained by distance rule. Old preprocessing excludes abs(D-D_base)<0.01 (tolerance-aware), not near-zero old epsilon. Runtime rejects supplied zero epsilon; sampler strictly positive.
zero_semantics.new: Exact Delta_P0 is undefined in calibration; exact Delta_D0 with nonzero Delta_P gives epsilon0, undefined for runtime P_max. Separately counted, not clipped. Near-zero retained for diagnostic.

comparison.positive_truncated_normal: Conditional Normal, renormalizes positive mass; fitted parent moments are not output moments.
comparison.folded_normal: abs(Normal) folds both tails; density f(x)+f(-x), not conditional Normal; absolute draw alone does not reproduce empirical ratio distribution.
comparison.empirical_bootstrap: Most faithful to the observed frozen-formula distribution and duplicate frequencies, conditional on explicit zero/support handling. Recommendation only; not implemented.

methodology_evidence: Final_Next_Implementation_Process.docx XML paragraphs56–57: Normal(epsilon_mean,sigma); ordinary Normal without mandatory truncation, bounds may be a later modelling choice. Paragraph96 repeats Normal sampling. This does not specify positive support or an empirical percentile floor; folding/bootstrap would require an explicit distribution-family decision.
remaining_decision: Choose runtime sampling family and handling/support of zero and small positive epsilon; decide whether to retain, replace or retire old distance-resolution exclusion. No percentile chosen.
